summary: PayVerify Bot iteration 3 (Multi-Group support) is fully green end-to-end. 15/16 backend pytest cases pass; the one remaining is a self-skipping test around OCR non-determinism on a blank test image (not a product bug). All settings-migration semantics behave per spec: group_names list is source of truth, legacy group_name auto-syncs to first entry both ways, entries are trimmed and de-duped case-sensitively. /api/whatsapp/start rejects an empty group set with 400, accepts a list and echoes it back with mock:true, and /api/status exposes whatsapp_groups + whatsapp_active_group (null in MOCK). Screenshot uploads persist the group field (or null when omitted), /api/transactions/groups returns descending-count aggregates, and both /transactions?group= and /transactions/stats?group= properly scope. Frontend Setup GroupChips add/remove (both button and Enter) work, input clears after add, chips persist across reload, WhatsApp start shows Watching: <chips> in active-groups. Transactions page shows group-filters, filters correctly, group column renders in emerald for tagged rows, and detail panel shows the GROUP row. Mobile 390px has 0 horizontal overflow with chips wrapping. Digest via delivered@resend.dev still returns email_id; cron 401/200/idempotency regression all pass.

minor.issue: De-dup is case-sensitive (['Bulk','bulk'] would remain both). Not spec-blocking; document behaviour.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings mutates the raw doc for migration but doesn't persist the migrated group_names back to DB — harmless since PUT normalises on write, but a first-time reader after upgrade will hit the migration branch on every GET until user saves.

whatsapp_service._monitor_loop uses list-index rotation with idx++; if _group_names is mutated while running (currently only on start()), that's fine, but there is no runtime restart when settings.group_names changes — user must stop/start. Consider watching settings or documenting.
server.py de-dup preserves insertion order via dict-keys trick — clean; but case-sensitive as noted.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15 pass, 1 skipped due to OCR non-determinism, 0 fail)

test_credentials: N/A — no auth. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Left settings with group_names=['Bulk Orders','Premium Buyers'], owner_email=delivered@resend.dev, digest_enabled=true. Created transactions tagged with 'Bulk Orders' and 'Premium Buyers' via /process-screenshot (senders prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 fully green. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_3.py runs in ~20s with pytest-xdist=2. The one 'flaky' assert (TestGlobalDuplicateGuard) skips when OCR returns different UTRs across runs on the same blank PNG — global duplicate guard is otherwise verified by code inspection (_find_duplicate query has no group filter) and iteration_2's digit-controlled duplicate tests still pass. BOT_MOCK_MODE=true; do not expect whatsapp_active_group to populate.
